Name: Gojocat Title Screen
Author: lunarmilktea
Description:
[size=4]Gojo Satoru aka Gojocat from Jujutsu Kaisen!

There are 2 versions, 1 with the glasses up and 1 with the glasses down~ It is random which one you get each time it loads.
And of course, you can click on it like the ConcernedApe for secret ^o^

By the way this is my first mod :3 It took me forever to draw it and I was struggling because I have never modded anything before.
It worked out and now the cutest Gojocat is here!
Also thank you to Vinilla for answering my questions quickly on the discord to help me make this!
[u]
[b]HOW TO USE:[/b][/u]
Just download and extract into your Mods folder!


[b][u]IN CASE OF CLASH:[/u][/b]
If you have other mods which replace the loading screen, for example any UI Recolor mods this mod will not work if those mods also recolour the loading title part.
1. Go to that mod and find the content.json file
2. Make a backup in case anything happens of that file
3. Find the code part which controls the loading screen part. You can press CTRL+F and search "TitleButtons" to find that part faster.Make sure this is the code for the loading screen and not the other title parts. [size=4]It should look something like this:[/size][code]
      "Action": "EditImage",
      "Target": "Minigames/TitleButtons",
      "FromFile": "assets/TitleButtons.png",
      "FromArea": {
        "X": 0,
        "Y": 307,
        "Width": 400,
        "Height": 137
[/code]4. Delete that section, now it shouldn't clash
5. Ctrl+S to save it, and launch the game, now the mod should work
6. If anything went wrong, use the backup you made of the content.json
[/size]
[size=4]
Happy Gojocat!
